finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit `0`, `0 errors`.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- `resolveRetries` in [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
- `isBackoffEnabled` in [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) rejected `undefined` flags, but the new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest of the noise was harmless deprecation/dedupe log spam, left alone.

Next: nothing.
